entries.title: Numbers 32:1
segments: The land of Jazer, and--of Gilead; east of Jordan, between the rivers Arnon and Jabbok.

entries.title: Numbers 32:4
segments: In selecting a place of residence, men often regard land, cattle, merchandise, and other earthly treasures, more than religious privileges, the favor of God, and treasures in heaven.

entries.title: Numbers 32:15
segments: By discouraging men from pursuing the path of duty, persons may be the means of destroying not only themselves, but multitudes of their fellow men.

entries.title: Numbers 32:18
segments: Kind remonstrances and timely explanations remove misunderstandings, and prevent multitudes of evils.

entries.title: Numbers 32:22
segments: Readiness to be satisfied with suitable explanations and with good reasons, is an indication of sound judgment, benevolent feeling, and an honest heart.

entries.title: Numbers 32:23
segments:
Your sin will find you out; it will bring punishment upon you. 
 
The idea that men may be selfish and continue in sin, and yet escape punishment, is vain.

entries.title: Numbers 32:27
segments: In promoting the cause of God and of human welfare, all should be disposed to bear their proportion of needful burdens, sacrifices, and labors.

entries.title: Numbers 32:30
segments: Among you; with the rest of the tribes on the west of Jordan.

entries.title: Numbers 32:33
segments:
Kingdom of Sihon; lying east of the Jordan near its mouth. 
 
  Kingdom of Og; a country north of Gilead, and east of the sea of Galilee. 
 
When God in his providence deprives one people of their possessions and gives them to another, he only does what he will with his own.  For all his dealings he has the wisest and best reasons, and he never afflicts individuals or nations beyond what their iniquities deserve.
